comment: Licences FARIS accepts in dependencies (LEG-003, SEC-039). AGPL-3.0 is compatible with the permissive licences below; GPL-2.0-only is not. An OR expression passes when any branch is allowed, an AND expression when every part is. An exception names one package and the exact expression it declares, so a changed declaration fails until reviewed. Edit this file only with the licence text in licenses/ and a line in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exceptions.licence: (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND OFL-1.1 AND Ubuntu-font-1.0
exceptions.reason: Font data bundled by egui, not linked code. OFL-1.1 and the Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 allow redistribution with the font; their texts are in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
